response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(HGB) AS o FROM Laboratory), p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), a AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - overall.o AS above_overall FROM p, overall WHERE p.avg_hgb > overall.o) SELECT ID, avg_hgb, above_overall, avg_hgb - AVG(avg_hgb) OVER () AS diff_from_group_avg FROM a ORDER BY diff_from_group_avg DESC LIMIT 10
